subject: Request: Short-term bridge credit + sandbox reactivation for WaveScale
messages:
From: Casey Alvarez <casey@wavescale.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jules Park <jules.park@wavescale.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trial expired — request to reactivate sandbox for one week while we finish eval

Hi Soojin,

We ran into an internal delay and our Redwood sandbox credits expired yesterday. We still have a week of exec bandwidth to finish a final latency/throughput benchmark before our procurement team signs off. Is there any way to temporarily reactivate the environment or grant a short bridge credit so we can finish the eval?

Quick context: we used about 55k tokens/day the last 5 days and have a small evaluation job that needs to run for 48 hours (approx. 120k tokens). Our goal is to validate autoscaling and cost targets before committing to Dedicated.

Appreciate any help — happy to share usage exports or sign a temporary terms doc.

Thanks,
Casey Alvarez
Head of Platform
WaveScale
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Casey Alvarez <casey@wavescale.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial expired — request to reactivate sandbox for one week while we finish eval

Hi Casey — thanks for the note and sorry for the interruption. We can usually do a short bridge for customers in this stage. Two quick asks so I can expedite with ops:

- Can you attach a quick export of last 7 days usage (tokens per day) — helps us size the top-up.
- Do you have a preferred billing contact for a temporary PO or simple pay-as-you-go charge if you decide to convert mid-run?

If you like, I can propose a 7-day credit equivalent to 150k tokens and a follow-up call to confirm scope. Marcus / Rishi, pinging you for approval for a one-week sandbox reactivation and the billing/terms doc to send Casey.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: Approve 7-day bridge credit for WaveScale (WS-2028-03)?

On Thu, Mar 15, 2028 at 11:05 AM Soojin Lee wrote:
> Hi Casey — thanks for the note and sorry for the interruption. We can usually do a short bridge for customers in this stage. Two quick asks so I can expedite with ops:...

Team — short summary: WaveScale had their trial credits expire yesterday. They’re requesting a 7-day/150k-token bridge while their exec and procurement finalize a Dedicated commitment. They’ve been ~55k tokens/day recently.

Proposal: approve a one-time 150k token credit (estimated value: small promo budget) with these conditions:
- Credit valid for 7 days, non-transferable, applies only to sandbox project id: wavescale-eval
- If they convert to a paid Dedicated contract within 14 days, we’ll apply a one-time offset credit equal to 25% of the top-up value
- Require signature on temporary terms (attached) and billing contact for emergency charge authorization

Requesting approval:
- Marcus: ok to authorize from promo pool?
- Rishi: any compliance flags we need on reactivating a sandbox in their org (account-level controls, data retention)?

Attaching: wavescale-usage.csv and draft bridge-credit-terms.pdf (stub).

Thanks —
Soojin

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: INTERNAL: Approve 7-day bridge credit for WaveScale (WS-2028-03)?

Approve. Small promo credit out of regional sandbox pool is fine — record under deal WS-2028-03.
Rishi: flag if anything from compliance side, otherwise ops can process the top-up and we can send the temporary terms to Casey.

On Thu, Mar 15, 2028 at 2:22 PM Soojin Lee wrote:
> Team — short summary: WaveScale had their trial credits expire yesterday...

Marcus Lin
VP, North America Sales
Redwood Inference
